blurb: Guests join fishing trips targeting various species including White Trout, Speckled Trout, Redfish, Flounder, and Red Snapper. Trips range from short, kid-friendly outings to extended offshore adventures. Fishing locations include oyster reefs, back bays, coastal waters, barrier islands, and offshore wrecks.
